paragraphs.text: The children put in words what the father disguised in his heart for the covetous think that whatever they cannot take, is taken from them.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: The God whom my fathers worshipped.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: God of my father hath been

paragraphs.text: This declares that the thing Jacob did before, was by God's commandment, and not through deceit.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: God hath taken away the cattle

paragraphs.text: This angel was Christ who appeared to Jacob in Bethel: and by this it appears that he had taught his wives the fear of God: for he talks as though they knew this thing.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: I am the God of Bethel

paragraphs.text: For they were given to Jacob as payment for his service, which was a kind of sale.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: For so the word here signifies, because Laban calls them gods, Ge 31:30.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He was an idolater and therefore would not acknowledge the God of Jacob for his God.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: God of your father spake unto

paragraphs.text: That is, the God whom Isaac feared and reverenced.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: His conscience reproved him for his misbehaviour toward Jacob, and therefore moved him to seek peace.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: The one named the place in the Syrian tongue, and the other in the Hebrew tongue.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Nature compels him to condemn that vice, to which through covetousness he forced Jacob.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Behold, how the idolaters mingle the true God with their false gods.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: Meaning, by the true God whom Isaac worshipped.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: We see that there is always some seed of the knowledge of God in the hearts of the wicked.
